name: Apify data tools — Mississippi Contractor License Status
purpose: Sell a source-linked, pay-per-use check of Mississippi contractor license status and expiration using the Mississippi State Board of Contractors public lookup.

your_steps.title: Your step: Set up Apify developer and payout details
your_steps.instruction: Complete the developer account, identity, and payout setup in your own account.

your_steps.title: Your step: Deploy the Actor
your_steps.command: cd ventures/apify-tools && npm exec --yes --package=apify-cli@1.10.0 -- apify login && npm exec --yes --package=apify-cli@1.10.0 -- apify push
your_steps.instruction: After creating the account and setting up payout details, paste this once from the repository root; the pinned CLI prompts you to log in and then deploys the Actor.

your_steps.title: Your step: Publish the first Actor
your_steps.instruction: Use store_listing.md, set $0.02 per lookup with platform usage included and a $2.00 run limit, then publish.
